d: Bihar ki rajdhani patna se is vakt ki sabse bari rajnitik khabar samne aa rahi hai. bahubli vidhayak anant sinh prakran, dularchand hatyakand, emaelsi chunav men bhitarghat aur vidhanasbha se jari notis ke bad janta dal yunaited (JDU) ke bhitar ghamasan macha huaa hai. isi prishthabhumi men mukhyamantri aavas par thori der bad jadyu ki ek behad uchchastariy aur mahatvapurn baithak hone ja rahi hai.
